script.base: Close HOME lean, not a blowout, at a 46 total. AWAY blitzes 71% and HOME QB is +0.38 EPA/dropback vs blitz (n=78) vs +0.24 unblitzed, so HOME stays on schedule and still hands PLY01 the ball (69 carries, 313 rush yds over L3, ~23/g). HOME blitzes only 28%, so AWAY QB mostly avoids his -0.17 blitz split (n=72) and plays the +0.07 unblitzed split, keeping primary target PLY04 (19 targets) in the game. No garbage-time assumption.
script.flip1: HOME jumps ahead off the blitz mismatch and salts it with PLY01. AWAY abandons the run (PLY05/PLY13/PLY12 carries die) and throws more toward PLY04/PLY11; HOME WR yardage can stall once the lead is safe.
script.flip2: Shootout: AWAY hangs around, HOME's pass tree (PLY09 33 tgt/297 yds, PLY08 21/240) clears with PLY01 mixing checkdowns, and HOME's middle leak (10.26 YPA, 29 passes of 20+ on 280 att) lets AWAY outproduce a clock-control script. Opposite of that: a slog if explosives don't land — AWAY allows only 12 passes of 20+ on 198 att — and both passing trees undershoot.

edge_players.edge_sentence: PLY01's L3 combined output is about 104 rush plus 35 receiving (139) against a 123.5 line, and the role fits the base script and the HOME-leads flip: ~23 carries against a merely average 4.16 YPC run defense, plus a 6.3-target, 3-air-yard checkdown role that AWAY's 71% blitz feeds while this QB's +0.38 blitz EPA keeps drives alive.
edge_players.must_be_true: Workload holds near 20 carries or 5+ targets with no silent snap cap, and HOME's offense stays on the field. His rush price of 89 does not signal a role cut, unlike the AWAY backfield lines.
edge_players.kills_it: A shootout or a blitz that actually stalls drives: carries fall to the mid-teens and the receiving role only adds ~35-45, so 123.5 is missed from both sides. An unlisted snap limit does the same.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. The +0.38 blitz EPA was a season aggregate that did not travel: AWAY's 71% blitz created negative plays, HOME drives died, and PLY01 never got the 20-carry or 5-target floor, so 104-plus-35 became something under 123.5 from both columns. Separately, HOME's 10.26 middle YPA was not available to PLY04 — the 29 explosives on 280 throws went to another alignment, AWAY's QB at +0.07 unblitzed was ordinary, and a HOME lead let them run clock before 6.3 targets accumulated, leaving PLY04 under 42.5. No inactives in the pack, so a late scratch of either player is an unpriced kill. The counter-case is real on price thinness (both -115, 3-game samples) but it is not stronger than the usage-plus-matchup read, so the legs stay, with PLY04 tagged lean.
slip_story: One story: competitive HOME-leaning game at -3.5 and 46, both offenses functional. Stack is HOME RB combined-yards over (lead script or blitz checkdowns) with AWAY WR1 intermediate over into the middle leak (keep-pace or chase). Not a blowout clock-kill stack and not a total-under mixed with same-game overs. No TDs, one market per player, two legs.
